#812 · Drummer Pokémon

Rillaboom

Grass

Galar · Generation 8

Rillaboom is a Grass-type Drummer Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 90 kg. It evolves from Thwackey. Its highest base stat is Attack (125), with a base stat total of 530.
